detection.weights_hint: Unified YOLOv8n detector (input [1,3,640,640], output [1,8,8400]). Class order MUST match classes: [wreck, debris, structure, tire] — supervised classes only (semantic review v3, docs/dataset-cards.md). ghost_net/pipe/cylinder are not trained (no verified data): they surface via the Unknown-Anomaly pathway.

segmentation.weights_hint: U-Net wreck-mask segmenter (static input/output [1,1,512,512] logits); the adapter resizes full-res images in and logits back out

classifier.weights_hint: Natural-vs-artificial CNN (input [1,1,64,64], output 2 logits — index 0 natural, index 1 artificial; adapter applies softmax)
